content.label: About Us
content.paragraph1: Established in 1994 under the name ENgineering & COnstruction TEChnologies, Encotec Inc. was formed to provide its clients with all their construction and renovation needs.
content.paragraph2: Our role has varied from site management and coordination to turn-key and design-build mandates. We strive during each project for positive team-oriented relationships with our clients, our consultants and our subcontractors.
content.paragraph3: Our team has shown the strength and flexibility to turn any challenge into a success. We define this success not only by the quality of construction and respect for budget and schedule, but also by the quality of the relationships we have built with our clients.

cta.description: Ready to start your next project? Get in touch with our team to discuss how we can help bring your vision to life.

content.label: Commercial Projects
content.paragraph1: Encotec brings decades of expertise to commercial construction and renovation projects across Montreal and beyond. From office buildings and retail spaces to hospitality venues and institutional facilities, we deliver exceptional results that meet the unique demands of commercial environments.
content.paragraph2: Our commercial portfolio spans a diverse range of sectors including hotels, corporate offices, healthcare facilities, educational institutions, and retail establishments. We understand the critical importance of minimizing disruption to your operations while maintaining the highest standards of quality and safety.
content.paragraph3: Whether you need a complete build-out, strategic renovations, or ongoing maintenance, our team coordinates every aspect of your project with precision and professionalism. We work closely with architects, engineers, and stakeholders to ensure your commercial space reflects your brand and serves your business objectives.

cta.title: Ready to Transform Your Commercial Space?
cta.description: Let's discuss your commercial project and how we can deliver exceptional results for your business.

content.label: Institutional Projects
content.paragraph1: Encotec specializes in institutional construction and renovation projects that demand precision, durability, and adherence to stringent safety standards. Our experience spans manufacturing facilities, warehouses, distribution centers, and specialized institutional environments across diverse sectors.
content.paragraph2: We understand the unique challenges of institutional construction — from heavy-duty infrastructure requirements and specialized electrical systems to material handling considerations and compliance with industry-specific regulations. Our team brings technical expertise and practical solutions to every institutional project.
content.paragraph3: From ground-up construction to facility upgrades and expansions, we coordinate all aspects of your institutional project with a focus on operational efficiency, safety, and long-term performance. Our turn-key approach ensures seamless integration of mechanical, electrical, and structural systems.

cta.title: Ready to Build Your Institutional Facility?
cta.description: Let's discuss your institutional construction needs and deliver a facility that supports your operations for years to come.

content.label: Residential Projects
content.paragraph1: Encotec brings craftsmanship and attention to detail to every residential project. From custom homes and luxury condominiums to multi-unit developments and heritage renovations, we create living spaces that combine beauty, functionality, and lasting quality.
content.paragraph2: Our residential portfolio includes single-family homes, apartment buildings, townhouse complexes, and high-end residential renovations. We understand that homes are personal spaces, and we work closely with homeowners, architects, and designers to bring your vision to life with meticulous care and professional execution.
content.paragraph3: Whether you're building a dream home from the ground up, renovating a heritage property, or developing a multi-unit residential complex, our team manages every detail with precision. We combine modern construction techniques with timeless craftsmanship to deliver residential spaces that stand the test of time.

cta.title: Ready to Build Your Dream Home?
cta.description: Let's bring your residential vision to life with craftsmanship and care that exceeds expectations.

Collections.bariloche-description: Bariloche is a well-established Spanish brand known for expert, feminine tailoring with elegant touches of meticulous detailing. Known for their impeccable sizing and fit, Bariloche’s high-quality, versatile garments are both fashion-forward and comfortable. They specialize in classic tailoring, crisp expertly crafted shirts, and exquisitely tailored European tweed jackets and coats.
Collections.calatura-description: Calatura is an Italian brand that offers a wide range of versatile, comfortable, and stylish garments that are perfect for everyday wear. Known for their high-quality textiles, Calatura’s collections are designed to be mixed and matched, allowing for a variety of looks that are both casual and sophisticated.
Collections.ecla-description: éclà is the newest brand by renowned Italian designer, Mirella Matteini: an urban-chic glamour line dedicated to women who love all that is feminine. Fashionable and sophisticated, this collection’s focus is quality textiles, innovative design, attention to detail, and a love of beauty, romance, and superior craftsmanship.
Collections.elisa-description: Elisa Cavaletti is a unique line of sophisticated but comfortable contemporary everyday garments designed in Italy by Daniela Dallavalle, as a celebration of inner beauty and joyful femininity. A versatile brand that speaks to women of a wide variety of styles, ages, and body-shapes, every season’s collections promise attention to detail, quality textiles, hand-detailing, and appealing, original prints.
Collections.gardel-description: Gardel by Moore is a deluxe jersey-wear collection of versatile and feminine womenswear made in Portugal. Featuring flattering, breezy, relaxed fit garments perfect for layering or as singular show-pieces, Gardel by Moore is known for their soft heathered textures, and uses only the finest of textiles, including Supima cotton, linen, modal, and wool.
Collections.soulmate-description: Soulmate is a Danish clothing brand that seeks to inspire a sense of femininity, independence, and individuality. Designed for the fashion-conscious woman with a clear sense of style, these garments are current, casual, and beautifully feminine, without compromising comfort.
Collections.tinta-description: Tinta Style is a popular Spanish fashion house that combines traditional tailoring with modern production processes to offer a fresh, feminine, modern twist on much-loved traditional styles, often featuring bold colours, vibrant prints, eye-catching lining, and hand-sewn detailing.
Collections.valentinas-description: VLT’S by Valentina’s is an Italian fashion brand set apart by the quality of its textiles, along with its attention to detail and impeccable finishing, designing garments of timeless style that are updated to lead current trends. VLT’S by Valentina’s is known for its distinctive detail elements, including superb buttons, specialized dyeing techniques, and highly sought-after traditional Tuscan embroidery.
